This short book speaks boldly about living in truth, recognizing God’s presence, and walking in genuine fellowship. Let this reading draw you deeper into its timeless message.

episodes.title: Book 63 · 2 John
episodes.ytTitle: 63 | The Book 2 JOHN (KJV) | Read By Alexander Scourby | AUDIO and TEXT | Synced Together.
episodes.synopsis: 2 JOHN warns believers to walk in TRUTH, practice LOVE, reject DECEIVERS, and guard the faith. John urges loyalty to Christ’s teaching, discernment against false doctrine, and steadfast obedience. 2 JOHN calls for the church and remain faithful to Christ’s Spoken Truth.

episodes.title: Book 64 · 3 John
episodes.ytTitle: 64 |The Book 3 JOHN (KJV) | Read By Alexander Scourby | AUDIO and TEXT | Synced Together. .
episodes.synopsis: 3 JOHN highlights truth, love, and faithful service as John commends Gaius for walking in truth, warns against Diotrephes’ pride, and praises Demetrius’ good testimony. This short letter urges believers to support godly workers, reject arrogance, and remain steadfast in Christian truth.

episodes.title: Book 65 · Jude

JUDE highlights vigilance, and steadfast hope in Christ’s ultimate triumph. episodes.title: Book 66 · Revelation
episodes.ytTitle: 66 | The Book of  REVELATION KJV) | Read By Alexander Scourby | AUDIO and TEXT | Synced Together.
episodes.synopsis: The Revelation unfolds on the island of Patmos, where John is caught up in the Spirit and shown the throne of God, the Lamb opening the seals, trumpet and bowl judgments shaking the earth, the rise and fall of Babylon, the final defeat of Satan, and the glory of the New Heaven and New Earth where God dwells with His people forever.
